prompt: ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of the Roc in Arabian Nights. ONE colossal WHITE BIRD with normal coherent bird anatomy: one avian head and great beak, TWO vast feathered wings, TWO strong clawed legs, white feathered body and one bird tail. visual_requirements: colossal white bird with two wings and two clawed legs
huge talons gripping one immense rock

visual_review.notes: Enormous white feathered bird with a single avian head/beak, two wings, two clawed legs and normal tail flies over sea island carrying one large boulder in both talons. Tiny sailing ship establishes giant scale; stern raptor stare and suspended rock convey awe and danger. Outer feather tips touch frame but diagnostic anatomy stays clear. No phoenix fire, hybrid face or invented limbs.
